final: WITH groups AS (SELECT t.tradekind, a.translink, COUNT(*) AS group_count FROM advancedbehavior AS a JOIN transactionrecord AS tr ON a.translink = tr.transreg JOIN trader AS t ON tr.trdref = t.tradereg GROUP BY a.translink, t.tradekind), ratios AS (SELECT g.tradekind, g.group_count, 1.0 * g.group_count / s.total_count AS ratio FROM groups AS g JOIN (SELECT tradekind, SUM(group_count) AS total_count FROM groups GROUP BY tradekind) AS s ON g.tradekind = s.tradekind), avgs AS (SELECT tradekind, AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio FROM ratios GROUP BY tradekind), kept AS (SELECT r.tradekind, r.group_count, r.ratio, r.ratio - a.avg_ratio AS difference FROM ratios AS r JOIN avgs AS a ON r.tradekind = a.tradekind WHERE r.ratio > a.avg_ratio) SELECT tradekind, AVG(group_count) AS average_group_count, AVG(ratio) AS average_ratio, AVG(difference) AS average_difference FROM kept GROUP BY tradekind
